title: Observability: early fips_gate failure emits no log
description: Five ioctl handlers (set_iv, gen_iv, set_aad, get_tag, set_tag) perform a pre-lock 'early_ops' fips_gate check and return the wolfCrypt error code raw with no log message whatsoever (lines 847-850, 908-911, 989-992, 1047-1050, 1101-1104 of crypto2dev_fd.c). A support engineer cannot determine from the ring buffer that a FIPS POST failure caused the ioctl to fail — they see only a raw wolfCrypt negative return from ioctl(2), no algo name, no provider name, no indication it is a FIPS failure rather than an argument error.
